name: GoHighLevel
one_liner: All-in-one CRM and marketing platform (HighLevel) for agencies and businesses, with contacts, conversations, calendars, opportunities and payments.
auth_notes: API v2 at services.leadconnectorhq.com. OAuth 2.0 for Marketplace apps; Private Integration tokens (static scoped bearer tokens generated in the UI) for single-account use. Legacy v1 API keys are end-of-life.
access_notes: A HighLevel account is required (pricing page offers a 14-day free trial). Pricing page lists 'Basic API access' under Unlimited and 'API Access' in features; which plan includes which endpoints is not clear. Marketplace listing review not verified.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve tokens on a paid account or trial; documented v2 REST API across many modules with webhooks and published rate limits (100 per 10s, 200k per day). Plan gating of API features and per-account install are caveats.

needs_human_reason: Confirm which plan tier includes API access; the pricing page and first-pass sources differ.

identity.quote: Complete REST API documentation for the HighLevel CRM platform.

auth.quote: Private Integrations, to put it simply, are static/fixed OAuth2 Access Tokens.

buildability.quote: Private Integrations are available for both Agencies and Sub-Accounts.

disputes.why: Official API v2 docs root exists.
Private Integration tokens are sent as Bearer tokens, matching enum bearer_token.
Docs list many modules (contacts, conversations, calendars, opportunities, payments); endpoints not counted, so inferred.

disputes.yours: Pricing page shows Basic API access under Unlimited; trial offered
disputes.why: Starter-plan API eligibility not supported by the pricing page fetched; unresolved.
